title: Sound a comb and paper
description: Hum through paper folded on a comb and stop when you choose.
oneStarDescription: Fold clean paper over the comb.
twoStarDescription: Hum one note through the paper.
threeStarDescription: Stop and show the paper is still on the comb.

title: Spin a ball on a finger
description: Spin a ball on one finger and catch it.
oneStarDescription: Get the ball turning on the finger.
twoStarDescription: Keep it up long enough to see.
threeStarDescription: Catch it when it tips. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can catch it.

title: Spin a book on a finger
description: Spin a light book on one finger and catch it when it tips.
oneStarDescription: Rest the book and find a still point.
twoStarDescription: Give it one turn and keep it up.
threeStarDescription: Catch the book when it tips.

title: Spin a card top
description: Make a top from card and a short stick, spin it, and say when it falls.
oneStarDescription: Fix a short stick through a card disc.
twoStarDescription: Spin the card top on a table so it turns before it falls.
threeStarDescription: Say when it falls and whether the stick stayed in.

title: Spin a coin and trap it
description: Spin a coin on a table and trap it under a hand without sliding it off.
oneStarDescription: Spin the coin so it turns on edge.
twoStarDescription: Cover it while it is still moving.
threeStarDescription: Lift the hand and show the face that landed, without calling it early.

title: Spin a pen and stop it
description: Spin a pen around your thumb and stop it in a writing grip.
oneStarDescription: Spin the pen once around the thumb.
twoStarDescription: Stop the pen in the hand, ready to write.
threeStarDescription: Write one word immediately after the stop.

title: Spin a plate on a stick
description: Spin a plate or a lightweight disc on a stick and keep it up for a moment.
oneStarDescription: Get the disc turning on the stick.
twoStarDescription: Keep it from falling for a moment a watcher can see.
threeStarDescription: Catch or lower it without a drop you ignore.

title: Spin a top and catch it
description: Spin a top and catch it while it is still turning, or let it spin out and say so.
oneStarDescription: Start the top on a flat surface.
twoStarDescription: Say when it is steady. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can see a steady spin.
threeStarDescription: Catch it while it turns, or say it fell before you caught it.

title: Spool-knit a few rounds
description: Knit a few rounds on a spool or a fork and pull the cord through.
oneStarDescription: Set the loops on the pegs.
twoStarDescription: Knit several rounds. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can knit rounds.
threeStarDescription: Pull the cord out and show the tube.

title: Spot a knot that will slip
description: Compare two tied cords and say which knot slips when you pull the free end.
oneStarDescription: Tie one firm knot and one slipped knot on scrap cord.
twoStarDescription: Pull each free end and say which opened.
threeStarDescription: Say which one you would use if you needed to undo it quickly.

title: Spot a repeated bead in a string
description: Find a color that repeats too soon in a bead string you made or were given.
oneStarDescription: Say the pattern you expect.
twoStarDescription: Point to the bead that breaks it.
threeStarDescription: Fix it if the string is yours, or mark it if it is not.

title: Spread cards in a row
description: Spread a small packet in an even row and square it again.
oneStarDescription: Spread the cards so each one shows an edge.
twoStarDescription: Point to two gaps and say whether they match.
threeStarDescription: Push the row back into a packet.

title: Spring a deck between your hands
description: Spring a small deck from one hand to the other so the cards arrive in a stack.
oneStarDescription: Square a deck you may bend a little.
twoStarDescription: Release the cards so they travel to the other hand.
threeStarDescription: Square the cards and say if any fell.

title: Stack cups and unstack them
description: Stack three cups into a pyramid and take them down into a nested stack.
oneStarDescription: Stack three cups so each sits in place.
twoStarDescription: Take them down into one nested stack.
threeStarDescription: Do both parts and say which part you rushed.

title: Stack dice to a sum you named
description: Stack dice so the top faces add to a sum you wrote before you started.
oneStarDescription: Write a small sum you can reach.
twoStarDescription: Stack dice to reach it. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can build the stack.
threeStarDescription: Read the top faces and say the total.

title: Stand a card triangle
description: Slot or lean cards into a triangle that stands, then set a light object on it or say it will not hold one.
oneStarDescription: Make one standing triangle.
twoStarDescription: Set a light coin on it or say it sags.
threeStarDescription: Point to the joint that held or failed.

title: Stick a balloon to a wall
description: Charge a balloon and stick it to a wall, then say when it falls.
oneStarDescription: Rub the balloon on hair or cloth.
twoStarDescription: Place it on the wall and let go.
threeStarDescription: Watch until it falls, or say it was still up when you stopped.

title: Stitch a cross-stitch row
description: Sew a short row of cross-stitches that all cross the same way.
oneStarDescription: Sew one X. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can sew one cross.
twoStarDescription: Sew several crosses in a row.
threeStarDescription: Point to the direction of the top stitch on each, and fix one that differs.

title: Stop when a sand timer ends
description: Turn a sand timer, start a small task, and stop when the sand finishes.
oneStarDescription: Turn it and show the sand running.
twoStarDescription: Keep the task going while sand remains.
threeStarDescription: Stop the task when the sand finishes, not before.

title: Strum a rubber-band box
description: Stretch bands over a box and play two different notes.
oneStarDescription: Put at least two bands on a box.
twoStarDescription: Pluck two bands and say which is higher.
threeStarDescription: Tighten or shorten one band and say what the note did.

title: Swing soft poi in one plane
description: Swing one soft poi in a flat circle beside your body.
oneStarDescription: Keep the circle next to the body, not across the face.
twoStarDescription: Change direction and keep the same plane.
threeStarDescription: Wrap or catch it against the body without a hit to the head.

title: Tap a word in Morse
description: Tap a short word in Morse from a chart you can see, then check it against the chart.
oneStarDescription: Choose a word of three or four letters.
twoStarDescription: Tap the letters from the chart, with a gap between letters.
threeStarDescription: Point back to the chart and correct one mistap, or say it matched.

title: Tape a costume hem
description: Tape a temporary hem that holds for a bow and peels off.
oneStarDescription: Tape the fold on the inside.
twoStarDescription: Bow or walk a few steps.
threeStarDescription: Peel the tape and show the cloth.

title: Tare a scale
description: Put a container on a scale, tare it, and weigh one thing inside it.
oneStarDescription: Zero the scale with the empty container on it.
twoStarDescription: Add one item and read the number.
threeStarDescription: Remove the item and say whether the scale returns to zero.

title: Teach a clap and stop the group
description: Teach two people a clap and stop them with a sign you agreed.
oneStarDescription: Agree the sign before you start.
twoStarDescription: Have them clap the pattern with you.
threeStarDescription: Give the sign and see them stop.

title: Teach a one-minute trick
description: Teach a trick that takes about a minute, and watch the learner do it.
oneStarDescription: Show the moves in order.
twoStarDescription: Watch them do it without taking the object back unless they ask.
threeStarDescription: Name one thing to change, or say it worked.

title: Tell a knit from a woven cloth
description: Tell a knit cloth from a woven cloth by the structure you can see or stretch.
oneStarDescription: Point to the loops or the crossed threads.
twoStarDescription: Stretch gently and say which one springs back more.
threeStarDescription: Name which is knit and which is woven, or say you are not sure.

title: Tell two screws apart by the thread
description: Tell two screws apart by the thread you can see, not only by the head.
oneStarDescription: Point to the threads on each.
twoStarDescription: Say one difference, such as fine or coarse, or that you cannot tell.
threeStarDescription: Place a third screw with the one it matches, or set it aside.

title: Thread a belt
description: Thread a belt through the loops so it sits flat and the end goes through the buckle.
oneStarDescription: Start the end at the buckle side.
twoStarDescription: Pass every loop. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can thread the loops.
threeStarDescription: Fasten it and show the end held.

title: Throw on an agreed count
description: Throw rock, paper, or scissors on a count you agreed, and say who won.
oneStarDescription: Say the count you will throw on.
twoStarDescription: Throw on that count, not before.
threeStarDescription: Name the winner, or say it was a tie.

title: Tie a bow on a package
description: Tie a bow on a wrapped package so the knot sits in the middle of one face.
oneStarDescription: Put the knot where you want it.
twoStarDescription: Tie the bow. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can tie it.
threeStarDescription: Turn it and say whether the bow stayed centered.

title: Tie a bow that survives a tug
description: Tie a gift bow and tug the loops without it coming undone.
oneStarDescription: Tie a bow with two loops.
twoStarDescription: Tug each loop once and say whether it held.
threeStarDescription: If it slips, retie it and tug again.

title: Tie a hair ribbon that stays
description: Tie a ribbon around a handle or a consenting ponytail so the bow survives a tug.
oneStarDescription: Tie a bow. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can tie it.
twoStarDescription: Tug the tails, not the hair.
threeStarDescription: Untie it without pulling hair.

title: Tie a knot you can release
description: Tie a slipped knot around a rail or a bag handle and release it by pulling the free end.
oneStarDescription: Tie a knot with a loop you can pull, around something fixed.
twoStarDescription: Tug the standing part and show the knot holds.
threeStarDescription: Pull the free end and show the knot opens.

title: Tie a lark's head on a ring
description: Tie a lark's head that holds a cord to a ring, then undo it.
oneStarDescription: Pass the cord through the ring and fold it back.
twoStarDescription: Pull so the hitch sits on the ring.
threeStarDescription: Undo the hitch and show the ring free.

title: Tie a scarf so it stays
description: Tie a scarf with one knot and turn your head without it falling.
oneStarDescription: Use one knot, not a stack of them.
twoStarDescription: Turn your head both ways.
threeStarDescription: If it slips, retie it once and test again.

title: Toss and catch a diabolo
description: Toss a diabolo up from the string and catch it on the string again.
oneStarDescription: Get the diabolo spinning on the string.
twoStarDescription: Toss it and catch it on the string.
threeStarDescription: Say whether it landed in the middle or ran to an end.

title: Trace a coin and fit it
description: Trace a coin and fit the same coin back into the circle.
oneStarDescription: Trace one coin. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can trace it.
twoStarDescription: Fit that coin into the circle.
threeStarDescription: Try a different coin and say whether it fits.

title: Trace a profile
description: Trace a consenting person's profile or your own shadow, and show the line.
oneStarDescription: Ask them to hold still, or use your own shadow.
twoStarDescription: Trace the outline once. Another person can confirm, from what they see or hear, that you can trace it.
threeStarDescription: Show the line and name one feature it caught.

title: Tune three bottles
description: Tune three bottles to three notes you can tell apart and play them in an order.
oneStarDescription: Make a note on each bottle.
twoStarDescription: Play them and say which is highest.
threeStarDescription: Play an order you said in advance.
